projectContext: Sprint 8 focuses on caption system reliability, cross-project cache management, and test coverage gaps. Sprint 7 delivered segment-level error recovery, adaptive format ordering, error categorization with retry budgets, metrics export, standalone validation CLI, batch pre-check optimization, network error pattern detection, timing-based confidence penalties, channel-level patterns, and stress tests. Sprint 8 advances: (1) Adaptive retry budget allocation across batches with pattern-aware backoff, (2) End-to-end timing penalty integration testing, (3) Multilingual caption testing with Unicode and fallback chains, (4) Cache staleness checking with max age enforcement, (5) Pattern-based abort recovery with checkpointing, (6) Segment quality scoring with accuracy heuristics, (7) Enhanced live stream detection with state classification, (8) Worker-level progress tracking with ETA calculation, (9) Edge case test suite for corrupted cache and malformed captions, (10) Config validation warnings for performance-degrading combinations.

userStories.title: Add adaptive retry budget allocation across video batches
userStories.description: Per-category retry budgets (US-003 Sprint 7) work per-video but not across batches. When 30% of videos fail with network errors, remaining videos should reduce retry attempts. Implement batch-level budget tracking that adapts retry strategy based on cumulative failure patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: Create BatchRetryBudget class tracking cumulative errors across all videos in batch
Implement budget_remaining(category) method returning reduced retry count when pattern detected
When >30% network errors, reduce subsequent video retry budget from 3 to 1
When >50% network errors, disable retries entirely for remaining videos
Add batch_retry_budget field to CaptionMetrics tracking original vs actual retries used
Tests verify batch with 40% network errors uses 60% fewer retries on remaining videos
userStories.notes: Implementation complete. Fixed RLock deadlock bug in get_summary() method. All 32 tests pass. BatchRetryBudget class tracks cumulative errors, reduces budget at >30% (to 1) and >50% (to 0) network errors.

userStories.title: Create end-to-end timing penalty integration test
userStories.description: Timing penalty (US-008 Sprint 7) is calculated in CaptionStage but may not survive pipeline to MatchStage. Create comprehensive integration test verifying timing_penalty flows through text_metadata and applies to final match confidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Create TestTimingPenaltyPipeline class in tests/test_caption_match_integration.py
Test verifies CaptionResult.timing_penalty_factor is calculated correctly
Test verifies timing_penalty stored in text_metadata by CaptionStage
Test verifies MatchStage retrieves timing_penalty from text_metadata
Test verifies apply_timing_penalty() reduces confidence: 0.9 * 0.75 penalty = 0.675
Test uses mock pipeline with real CaptionStage and MatchStage integration
userStories.notes: Implementation complete. Added 19 new tests in 3 classes: TestTimingPenaltyPipeline (13 tests), TestTimingPenaltyEdgeCases (5 tests), TestTimingPenaltyPipelineSmokeTest (1 test). All tests verify the full timing penalty flow from CaptionResult through text_metadata to MatchStage confidence adjustment. Specific test_apply_timing_penalty_reduces_confidence verifies 0.9 * 0.75 = 0.675.

userStories.title: Add multilingual caption fetching test suite
userStories.description: Language fallback chains lack comprehensive testing. Add test suite covering partial failures, Unicode handling, mixed-language videos, and language code case sensitivity.
acceptanceCriteria: Create TestMultilingualCaptions class in tests/test_caption_multilingual.py
Test fallback chain: preferred unavailable, 2nd fallback succeeds (en -> es -> de)
Test Unicode handling: German umlauts, Chinese characters, Arabic RTL text
Test mixed-language video: captions in en + es available, preferred en returned
Test language code normalization: 'EN' treated same as 'en'
Test empty fallback_languages defaults to 'en' gracefully
All 6 tests pass with clear assertions on language selection logic
userStories.notes: Implementation complete. Created tests/test_caption_multilingual.py with 12 tests in 3 classes: TestMultilingualCaptions (6 tests covering all acceptance criteria), TestMultilingualCaptionValidation (2 tests for config validation), TestMultilingualCaptionSegments (2 tests for Unicode preservation in segments). All tests verify language selection, Unicode handling for German/Chinese/Arabic, and graceful fallback behavior.

userStories.title: Implement cache staleness checking with max age enforcement
userStories.description: CaptionCache stores results indefinitely with no staleness check. Implement max_cache_age_days enforcement that marks old entries for re-fetch and provides cleanup mechanism.
acceptanceCriteria: Add cached_at timestamp to CaptionCacheEntry when storing results
Implement is_stale(entry) method checking age against config.cache_validation.max_cache_age_days
CaptionCache.get() returns None for stale entries when config.cache_validation.mode='strict'
Add cleanup_stale_entries(max_age_days) method removing entries older than threshold
Add --cleanup-caption-cache CLI flag that removes stale entries and reports freed space
Tests verify stale entries skipped in strict mode, returned with warning in warn mode

userStories.title: Add pattern-based abort recovery with partial result checkpointing
userStories.description: Error pattern detection (US-007 Sprint 7) triggers abort but loses partial results. Implement checkpointing that saves successfully fetched captions before abort, allowing resume from partial state.
acceptanceCriteria: Create CaptionBatchCheckpoint class storing video_id -> CaptionResult map
Save checkpoint every 10 successful fetches during batch operation
On ErrorPatternAbortError, save checkpoint with abort_reason and pattern_info
Add resume_from_checkpoint() method to CaptionFetcher loading partial results
CaptionStage checks for checkpoint and skips already-fetched videos on resume
Tests verify abort at video 50/100 saves 50 results, resume fetches remaining 50

userStories.title: Create sophisticated segment quality scoring heuristics
userStories.description: Current quality scoring (low/medium/high) is simplistic. Implement accuracy heuristics considering segment density, timing precision, and text completeness for better quality classification.
acceptanceCriteria: Add SegmentQualityMetrics dataclass: density_score, timing_precision, text_completeness
Implement calculate_segment_metrics() analyzing segment timestamps and text
density_score: segments per minute (normalize to 0-1 scale)
timing_precision: percentage of segments with exact millisecond timestamps
text_completeness: average characters per segment vs expected (50-200 chars)
Combine into quality_score: 0.4*density + 0.3*precision + 0.3*completeness
Tests verify sparse human captions score higher than dense auto-generated

userStories.title: Enhance live stream detection with state classification
userStories.description: Live stream detection only checks is_live metadata. Enhance to classify stream states (LIVE, UPCOMING, VOD) and handle UPCOMING streams that will have captions when complete.
acceptanceCriteria: Create StreamState enum: LIVE, UPCOMING, VOD, PREMIERE, UNKNOWN
Implement classify_stream_state() checking live_status, scheduled_start, duration
UPCOMING streams added to pending_streams list instead of skipped
Add config option caption_first.handle_upcoming: 'skip', 'queue', 'check_later'
Log stream state: 'UCabc: UPCOMING (scheduled 2026-01-27 10:00 UTC)'
Tests verify all 5 stream states detected correctly from mock metadata

userStories.title: Add worker-level progress tracking with ETA calculation
userStories.description: Progress reporting shows completed count but not per-worker status or ETA. Add detailed tracking showing which workers are stuck and estimated completion time.
acceptanceCriteria: Create WorkerProgress dataclass: worker_id, current_video, start_time, videos_completed
Track active workers in CaptionFetcher.worker_progress dict
Implement calculate_eta() using rolling average of last 10 fetch times
Progress callback includes worker stats: 'Workers: 8 active, 1 slow (video abc >30s)'
Add stuck_worker_threshold config (default 60s) for slow worker detection
Tests verify ETA calculation accurate within 20% for batch of 50 videos

Test truncated cache file (partial write) detected and handled

userStories.title: Add config validation warnings for performance-degrading combinations
userStories.description: Config allows combinations that degrade performance (50 workers, 5 fallback languages, low timeouts). Add validation that warns users about problematic settings.
acceptanceCriteria: Create CaptionConfigWarning dataclass: setting, current_value, recommended, reason
Implement validate_caption_config_warnings() returning list of warnings
Warn when max_parallel_fetches > 16 (system thread pool limits)
Warn when retry_delay < 1s (aggressive retrying)
Warn when fallback_languages > 3 (slow fetch multiplier)
Warn when timeout < 5s combined with fallbacks > 1 (timeout cascade)
Print warnings at pipeline start: 'Caption config warning: max_parallel_fetches=50 exceeds optimal 16'
